differences.what: A module, exam_foot, that the General note type includes: its section Foot / diabetic foot exam shows only while Foot (exam.systems is diabetic_foot) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10

differences.what: The guidance line is not typed: Foot is one picker entry like any other.

Inspection is choose-many. Intact skin is the normal option and is not exclusive: intact skin is charted with a callus, corn, deformity, nail abnormality, erythema or swelling beside it, and only the breaks in the skin, Ulcer, Fissure, Blister and Necrosis, are excluded.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 13, 17, 25, 26 (a reading of default 13, as for Moist: Intact skin says only that the skin is unbroken); PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #23): the clinical team confirms which normal options are held beside a finding

differences.what: Pulses is a grid with the rows Dorsalis pedis (DP) and Posterior tibial (PT) (added: the check reads a heading as no word), recorded for the right and the left (sides): the bullets Right and Left are its cells. Each cell is choose-one from the shared list pulse_scale: 0, 1+, 2+, 3+, Unable to assess (all added: the scale is written inside the bullets). Unable is the scale's Unable to assess. Normal fills 2+.
Sensation is choose-one: Intact (the normal option), Decreased, Absent.
Monofilament is one choose-one, Normal (the normal option) or Abnormal, recorded for the right and the left (sides): the headings Right and Left are its sides.
Temperature is choose-many. Warm is the normal option; it does not clear Asymmetric, and it excludes Cool.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 13, 17, 25, 26; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): Warm is kept with Asymmetric rather than cleared by it

differences.what: Wound Present? is choose-one: Yes (added) or No. One-tap Normal leaves it unanswered: it fills only what is empty, and would write No beside an ulcer, fissure, blister or necrosis already ticked in Inspection, which hides the hand-off. While it is Yes, an action, Chart in Wound care, opens the encounter's Wound care note (open_note_type wound_care), and the wound is charted there. Wound present? is not asked while Inspection holds Intact skin, so the two never stand together: Normal fills Intact skin only where it would hide no answer, so it leaves Inspection empty beside Wound present? Yes.
differences.why: PRD main 416; forms 6.7, 7.1 (Normal never hides an answer that counts); PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1, #29): a departure from focused-exam inventory default 29, which has Normal fill every field with a normal finding

differences.what: The workflow requirement is the action at line 73; the line is not typed.

Notes, a text box at the end of the section (not in the lines), is the free text default 25 gives Inspection and Temperature, which have no side: which foot a callus or deformity is on, and which foot is warmer when Temperature is Asymmetric.
differences.why: PRD main 414 (left and right are recorded where it matters); focused-exam inventory default 25 (one list plus free text); PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): a side for these findings, for the clinical team
